channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Goh Choon Aik sworn in as Penang exco member
item.description: Bukit Tambun assemblyman Goh Choon Aik sworn in as Penang exco, taking over trade and community unity portfolios in a state cabinet reshuffle.

item.title: RM10.5 billion federal boost to spur state development nationwide
item.description: Penang CM welcomes increased federal allocation to states, calling it a proactive step to strengthen fiscal positions and drive socio-economic development.

item.title: FGV’s new CEO to be appointed from professional ranks
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi says FGV's new CEO will be a professional, with a prompt appointment needed to avoid a leadership gap.

item.title: PM Anwar visits JPA for first time during Ramadan programme
item.description: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's first official visit to the Public Service Department focused on reform, efficiency, and human capital development.

item.title: CAS partially overturns FIFA ban on Malaysian heritage players
item.description: The Court of Arbitration for Sport has reduced the suspensions for seven heritage players, limiting bans to official matches only, while upholding FAM's fine.

item.title: PM awaits AG’s report on MACC chief’s shareholding issue
item.description: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim says he is awaiting the Attorney General's report on the MACC chief's shareholding before making any statement.

item.title: Urgent action needed to foil attempts to topple government
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi calls for immediate action against attempts to undermine political stability, citing ongoing police investigations.

item.title: Malay-Islamic parties meet to strengthen national agenda
item.description: Deputy PM Ahmad Zahid says meeting aimed to share facts on government policies and address concerns over Islam and Bumiputera interests.

item.title: Sarawak election looms as political tensions heat up
item.description: SUPP president Dr Sim Kui Hian warns of divisive rhetoric as Sarawak braces for imminent state polls

item.title: vivo unveils V70 in Malaysia
item.description: Latest smartphone shows off telephoto zoom, AI tools, sleek aluminium design vivo Malaysia has launched the vivo V70, introducing its latest camera-focused smartphone built around portrait photography, zoom imaging and artificial intelligence (AI) features.
